description:
Return one saved chart in full: birth date, time and time zone (no birthplace), pillars with Ten Gods, hidden stems and Na Yin, all luck pillars (current one marked), palaces, the stored Day Master strength and favorable elements, and today's pillars.
Use whenever the user asks about a saved chart or "my chart"; luck pillars and judgment are included. chart_id comes from list_saved_charts, or "self" for the user's own chart.
Not for births not saved (use cast_bazi_chart). Never re-cast or re-judge a saved chart with other tools. Not for predicting events or years of accident, illness or death.

chart_id.description: chart_id from list_saved_charts, or "self" for the account holder's own chart.

include_today.description: Default true. When false, today's pillars are omitted (today is null).

locale.description: Language of the chart card shown to the user, as a BCP 47 tag, normally the language the user is writing in. Only zh-CN, zh-TW and en are supported; any other language falls back to en.

name: get_saved_chart

Pillar.description: One of the four pillars with its elements.

branch_element.description: Five Element of the branch (main qi).

ganzhi.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

hidden_stems.description: Hidden stems of the branch, main qi first, then middle and residual qi.

element.description: Five Element of the hidden stem.

ten_god.description: Ten God of the hidden stem relative to the Day Master.

life_stage.description: Twelve-stage (Chang Sheng) state of the Day Master's stem on this pillar's branch; yang stems run forward, yin stems backward.

nayin.description: Na Yin of this stem-branch pair.

ten_god.description: Ten God of the stem relative to the Day Master; null for the day pillar (the Day Master itself).

Term.description: A BaZi term as {code, zh, en}.

zh.description: Chinese term as used by FateTell, e.g. "伤官".

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace; null for older charts.

conventions.description: Chart conventions used for this result.

calendar_input.description: Calendar of the birth date given in this call; null for saved charts, whose input calendar is not recorded.

hemisphere.description: Hemisphere the chart was computed for.

hour_boundary.description: From 23:00 local time (true solar time when applied) the day pillar is the next day and the hour pillar is Zi counted from that next day; there is no early/late Zi split.

month_adjusted.description: Whether the month pillar was adjusted for the southern hemisphere (FateTell cross-region rules, v1 charts only).

true_solar_applied.description: Whether the birth time was corrected to true solar time.

year_boundary.description: The year pillar changes at the exact Start of Spring (Li Chun) instant, not at Lunar New Year.

element.description: Five Element of the Day Master.

engine_version.description: FateTell calculation engine version (package version + commit).

anyOf.description: FateTell's Day Master strength and favorable elements under its rule set.

branch_overrides.description: Branches whose verdict differs from their element: unfavorable, mixed, or favorable_with_flow.

rank.description: 1 is the most favorable (or most unfavorable); null when unranked.

legacy.description: True when the stored judgment was projected from older account fields; ranks are then null.

neutral.description: Elements that are neither favorable nor unfavorable.

rule_version.description: FateTell rule set version: v1.0, or legacy when the judgment was projected from older account fields.

rank.description: 1 is the most favorable (or most unfavorable); null when unranked.

verdict.description: Day Master strength: strong, weak, follow_strong or follow_weak.

judgment.description: Null when the account has no stored judgment for this chart.

links.description: FateTell web pages for objects in this result, for citation. Only objects already present in the result are linked.

rel.description: Which FateTell page this is: chart, daily_fortune, luck_pillars or account.

url.description: Page in the FateTell web app for an object that appears in this result.

locale.description: Chart card language resolved from the locale argument. Absent when no valid locale was given.

luck_pillars.description: Luck pillars (Da Yun) as stored with the chart.

start_age.description: Age when the first luck pillar starts, East Asian count.

start_year.description: Gregorian year when the first luck pillar starts.

end_year.description: Gregorian year this luck pillar ends (start_year + 9).

ganzhi.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

start_age.description: Age at start, counted in East Asian years (born at age 1, +1 at each Start of Spring).

start_year.description: Gregorian year this luck pillar starts.

stem_ten_god.description: Ten God of the luck pillar stem relative to the Day Master.

moments.description: Calendar facts about this date: luck_pillar_change_in (value = months), solar_term_today, annual_clash (year branch clashes the natal year branch), birth_year_return (year pillar equals the natal year pillar), month_clash, energy_extreme (high or low energy), birthday_window (within 7 days of the birthday).

value.description: Only for luck_pillar_change_in: months until the next luck pillar starts.

month_pillar_raw.description: Northern-hemisphere month pillar; equals pillars.month.ganzhi for northern charts.

notes.description: Codes for facts that qualify this result: hour_assumed (no birth time, 12:00 used), true_solar_skipped_no_longitude, southern_month_adjusted, palace_formula_lunar_javascript (life and body palaces follow the lunar-javascript formula), legacy_v0_chart, judgment_unavailable, chart_pending, truncated, lunar_converted (the birth date was given in the lunar calendar and converted to Gregorian).

paipan_version.description: Chart rule version. Charts computed now are always v1 (FateTell cross-region rules).

palaces.description: Palaces derived from the chart; month-based palaces use the adjusted month pillar.

rule_version.description: Present when a judgment is included: v1.0, or legacy for a judgment projected from older account fields.

anyOf.description: Today's pillars, taken at 12:00 Beijing time of that date.

date.description: Today in the given time zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

day_pillar.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

month_clash.description: Whether the day branch clashes with the month branch.

month_pillar.description: Month pillar for this chart, adjusted for the southern hemisphere when applicable.

year_pillar.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

today.description: Today's pillars for this chart; null when include_today is false.

tzdata_version.description: IANA time zone database version used by the server.

title: Get saved chart
